spec.obtain: crm.lofty.com -> Settings -> Integrations -> API Keys -> Create API Key (name + accept the agreement). The key is a JWS; send it as `Authorization: token <key>`.
gotchas: PAT uses `Authorization: token <JWS>` (NOT Bearer; Bearer is only for OAuth).
Account-scoped even under a MaxCRM white-label (verified: /v1.0/leads returns your own account's leads).
Rate limits 100/min (dev) / 500/min (prod). Base https://api.lofty.com. Endpoints: /v1.0/leads CRUD, /v2.0/leads/{id}/activities, /v1.0/systemLogs.
